name: git-parity
description: Keep local and remote git branches in parity across many repositories: safe fast-forward sync, push and PR offers, and a short report with next steps.

interface.shortDescription: Multi-repo git sync with a short report
interface.longDescription: Check every repository you work on, fast-forward what is safe, offer to push what is only local, and get one short report with the next step for everything else. Never forces, resets, stashes or pushes without a yes.
defaultPrompt: Are my repositories in sync with their remotes?
Bring all my repositories up to date.
What have I not pushed yet?
